name: Lands' End Data Breach Settlement (Jones, et al. v. Lands' End, Inc.)
summary: Settlement resolving claims over a December 2024 data breach affecting Lands' End customers. Offers about $60 cash with no proof, or up to $5,000 for documented losses.

eligibilityQuestions.text: Did you receive a notice from Lands' End about a data breach that occurred in December 2024?
Do you reside in the United States?
